name: aponiajs-workspace
description: Bun-first application architecture powered by Elysia.

scripts.docs:api: bun run scripts/build-api-reference.ts && bun run --cwd tools/api-docs build
scripts.version:sync: bun scripts/sync-version-references.ts && bun install --lockfile-only && bun run release:verify
scripts.version:bump: bumpp package.json packages/aponiajs/package.json packages/auth/package.json packages/cache/package.json packages/cli/package.json packages/common/package.json packages/compiler/package.json packages/compression/package.json packages/config/package.json packages/core/package.json packages/cors/package.json packages/cqrs/package.json packages/create-aponia/package.json packages/cron/package.json packages/database/package.json packages/devtools/package.json packages/events/package.json packages/graphql/package.json packages/http/package.json packages/idempotency/package.json packages/mapped-types/package.json packages/mcp/package.json packages/metrics/package.json packages/microservices/package.json packages/nitro/package.json packages/opentelemetry/package.json packages/serverless/package.json packages/openapi/package.json packages/platform-elysia/package.json packages/platform-h3/package.json packages/platform-hono/package.json packages/queue/package.json packages/rate-limit/package.json packages/redis/package.json packages/security/package.json packages/schematics/package.json packages/serve-static/package.json packages/session/package.json packages/terminus/package.json packages/view/package.json packages/testing/package.json --all --no-commit --no-tag --no-push --execute "bun run version:sync"
scripts.release:dry-run: status=0; for package in auth cache compression config cqrs events http idempotency common compiler core platform-elysia platform-h3 platform-hono queue schematics cli create-aponia devtools cron database cors graphql mapped-types mcp metrics microservices opentelemetry serverless nitro testing openapi rate-limit redis security serve-static session terminus view; do bun pm pack --cwd packages/$package --dry-run || status=1; done; exit $status
